summary: OrcaRouter offers a rotating set of $0 models for established accounts. The offers page currently shows 0 vouchers and 0 credit drops, so no live voucher, student, or hackathon credit grant is promised. To access always-free models, the workspace owner must link a GitHub account with some history (or use it to sign in), or the workspace must have a paid purchase of any amount. Free models require no credit and stay free while they remain in the lineup; rate and prompt-size limits apply. Check the current catalog for -free model IDs or use the orcarouter/free router; the lineup rotates as capacity allows.
claim_steps: Create an account at orcarouter.ai (the offers page says an API key takes 30 seconds; no card, no sales call).
Ensure the workspace owner has a GitHub account with some history linked in profile settings or used for sign-in; a paid purchase of any amount is the alternative established-account requirement.
Check orcarouter.ai/offers or the current catalog for rotating $0 models. The offers page currently lists 0 vouchers and 0 credit drops.
Call orcarouter/free or a current -free catalog ID on the OpenAI-compatible endpoint, subject to free-model rate and prompt-size limits.

social_proof.title: Free Models
social_proof.text: The free lineup rotates — models join and leave as capacity allows — so this page deliberately does not list ids. Read the catalog at the time you need it, or call GET /api/free-package/public, which returns the current free ids with the paid model each one shadows.

social_proof.title: OrcaRouter Free — difficulty-routed free models
social_proof.text: Call orcarouter/free and it routes each request by difficulty across your workspace's free models — never touching your wallet, with free use capped by request rate rather than a fixed number of calls.
